name: ArcRoute AI - Intelligent Customer Request Triage

nodes.name: Webhook - Receive Request
nodes.notes: Receives customer requests from email, web forms, or support portals. Configure webhook auth before production use.

nodes.name: Normalize Input
nodes.notes: Normalizes webhook payloads and records validation errors before any LLM call.

nodes.name: IF - Input Valid
nodes.notes: Prevents invalid input from calling Groq or writing to normal request queues.

nodes.name: Create Validation Error Response
nodes.notes: Creates a structured 400 response for missing or empty raw_message. This path does not write to Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Respond Invalid Request
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 400 when supported by this n8n version. If your n8n version stores response code elsewhere, set it manually after import.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $json.model_name, temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: `You are ArcRoute AI, an intake classifier for ArcVault customer requests. Return valid JSON only. Do not include markdown, comments, prose, or code fences. Classify based on primary intent. Use semantic understanding for classification and enrichment only. Do not choose destination queues, do not decide human escalation, and do not apply deterministic routing rules. Valid categories: Bug Report, Feature Request, Billing Issue, Technical Question, Incident/Outage. Valid priorities: Low, Medium, High. Valid urgency values: None, Low, Medium, High. Do not invent facts. Use null for unavailable scalar values and [] for unavailable arrays. When monetary values appear, extract each value into identifiers.amounts. Use billed_amount for the invoice or charged amount, expected_amount for the contract or expected rate, and other_amount for any other monetary value. Each amount must have {"label":"billed_amount | expected_amount | other_amount","value":0,"currency":"USD"}. Do not leave amounts empty when explicit monetary values appear in the customer message. Return exactly this object: {"category":"Bug Report | Feature Request | Billing Issue | Technical Question | Incident/Outage","priority":"Low | Medium | High","confidence_score":0,"core_issue":"One concise sentence.","identifiers":{"account_reference":null,"invoice_number":null,"error_code":null,"amounts":[{"label":"billed_amount | expected_amount | other_amount","value":0,"currency":"USD"}],"time_references":[],"authentication_provider":null,"affected_users":null},"urgency_signal":"None | Low | Medium | High","urgency_reason":"Short explanation based only on the message.","customer_impact":"Concise impact description.","requires_follow_up_information":true,"missing_information":[],"human_readable_summary":"Two or three concise sentences."}. identifiers.amounts may be [] only when no money appears.` }, { role: 'user', content: `Source: ${$json.source}\nReceived at: ${$json.received_at}\nMessage: ${$json.raw_message}` } ] } }}

nodes.name: LLM - Classify and Enrich

httpHeaderAuth.name: Groq API Header Auth - configure manually

nodes.notes: Calls Groq with a low temperature. Configure HTTP Header Auth as Authorization: Bearer <GROQ_API_KEY>. Continue-on-fail lets the workflow retry or fall back without exposing secrets.

nodes.name: Parse and Validate JSON
nodes.notes: Validates top-level and nested LLM fields. Safe minor normalization is allowed; invented facts are not.

nodes.name: IF - LLM Output Valid
nodes.notes: Valid output continues to deterministic rules. Invalid output gets one retry.

nodes.name: Retry Invalid LLM Output

httpHeaderAuth.name: Groq API Header Auth - configure manually

nodes.notes: Performs one retry with the complete schema, original message, and previous validation errors.

nodes.name: Parse Retry JSON
nodes.notes: Uses the same validation rules as the initial parser. Repeated failure becomes a fallback Human Review record.

nodes.name: Calculate Billing Difference
nodes.notes: Calculates billing discrepancy deterministically when both billed and expected amounts are available.

nodes.name: Determine Recommended Queue
nodes.notes: Applies deterministic queue mapping. The LLM does not choose queues.

nodes.name: Evaluate Escalation Rules
nodes.notes: Applies auditable escalation rules outside the LLM.

nodes.name: Set Final Queue
nodes.notes: Preserves recommended_queue and overrides final_queue only for escalated records.

parameters.jsCode:
const r = { ...$json };
r.processed_at = new Date().toISOString();
const finalRecord = {
  request_id: r.request_id,
  source: r.source,
  received_at: r.received_at,
  raw_message: r.raw_message,
  category: r.category,
  priority: r.priority,
  confidence_score: r.confidence_score,
  core_issue: r.core_issue,
  identifiers: r.identifiers,
  urgency_signal: r.urgency_signal,
  urgency_reason: r.urgency_reason,
  customer_impact: r.customer_impact,
  requires_follow_up_information: r.requires_follow_up_information,
  missing_information: r.missing_information,
  recommended_queue: r.recommended_queue,
  final_queue: r.final_queue,
  escalation_flag: r.escalation_flag,
  escalation_reasons: r.escalation_reasons,
  human_readable_summary: r.human_readable_summary,
  model_name: r.model_name,
  workflow_version: r.workflow_version,
  processed_at: r.processed_at
};
return [{ json: finalRecord }];

nodes.name: Create Final Record
nodes.notes: Creates the final output schema. Spreadsheet rows are prepared in separate nodes so webhook response remains the actual final JSON.

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $json;
return [{ json: {
  'Request ID': r.request_id,
  'Source': r.source,
  'Raw message': r.raw_message,
  'Category': r.category,
  'Priority': r.priority,
  'Confidence': r.confidence_score,
  'Core issue': r.core_issue,
  'Identifiers': JSON.stringify(r.identifiers),
  'Urgency': r.urgency_signal,
  'Recommended queue': r.recommended_queue,
  'Final queue': r.final_queue,
  'Escalation flag': r.escalation_flag,
  'Escalation reasons': JSON.stringify(r.escalation_reasons),
  'Summary': r.human_readable_summary,
  'Processed timestamp': r.processed_at
}}];

nodes.name: Prepare All Requests Sheet Row
nodes.notes: Outputs top-level fields matching the exact All Requests sheet headers.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Store All Records
nodes.notes: Stores every valid processed request. Invalid raw_message requests are returned before this node.

nodes.name: IF - Escalated
nodes.notes: Sends only escalated records to the Human Review Queue sheet.

nodes.notes: Stores only records where escalation_flag is true.

nodes.name: Webhook Response
nodes.notes: Returns the completed final JSON record, not the Google Sheets node output.

meta.notes: Credential IDs and Google Sheets document ID must be configured manually in n8n. Do not commit real secrets.
